english.title: Sort over / disturb waste - Environmental Protection Act 1990
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without a relevant consent or right as provided by section 60(2) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990, sorted over or disturbed

(A)_[something deposited at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), a place for the deposit of waste,]_
(B)_[something deposited in a receptacle for waste]_
(C)_[the contents of a receptacle for waste which was placed on a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), in accordance with a requirement under section 46 or 47 of the Act]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 60 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.

english.notes:
Section 60(2) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 provides that the consent or right that is relevant for the purposes of section 60 of the Act is:-
(a) the consent of the authority or other person who provides the place for the deposit of the waste.
(b) the consent of the authority or other person who provides the receptacle for the deposit of the waste.
(c) the consent of the person having the right to the custody of the receptacle or the right conferred by the function by or under this Part of emptying such receptacles.
